# RTK - Rust Token Killer (Codex CLI)

**Usage**: Token-optimized CLI proxy for shell commands.

## Rule

Always prefix shell commands with `rtk`.

Examples:

```bash
rtk git status
rtk cargo test
rtk npm run build
rtk pytest -q
```

## Meta Commands

```bash
rtk gain            # Token savings analytics
rtk gain --history  # Recent command savings history
rtk proxy <cmd>     # Run raw command without filtering
```

## Verification

```bash
rtk --version
rtk gain
which rtk
```

name: agy
description: >-
  Invokes Google Antigravity CLI through RTK when an agent should delegate a
  coding, research, review, or orchestration task to AGY, including the
  default review of frontend changes.
---

# Antigravity CLI

Always launch Antigravity through `rtk agy` with
`--dangerously-skip-permissions`. The user has explicitly chosen this as the
machine-wide default (YOLO mode). Use `--print` for delegated one-shot work and
the interactive form only when an interactive session is wanted. Keep the
caller's task scope even though tool permission prompts are bypassed. A model
or effort explicitly requested by the user overrides the defaults below.

## Default model and effort

Use `gemini-3.8-flash-high` with `--effort high` for all task sizes, including
orchestration, implementation, review, and tiny tasks. Pass both flags on every
invocation, including resumed sessions. Do not switch to Medium or Luna based
on task size. If the requested model is unavailable, report the error instead
of silently selecting a different model.

## Required frontend review

For every frontend implementation or UI change, obtain a four-way AGY review
before handoff. Frontend work includes component markup, styles, responsive
layouts, interaction states, accessibility-facing UI, and visual assets. Run
four independent, review-only delegated one-shots in parallel after local
checks. Do not share one reviewer's output with another before they respond.
Review does not authorize the reviewers to modify files or expand the user's
scope.

- Use `gemini-3.8-flash-high` with `--effort high` for all four reviewers,
  regardless of the size of the frontend change.
- Assign distinct perspectives: (1) visual hierarchy and design consistency,
  (2) responsive behavior and accessibility, (3) interaction states, data
  handling, and frontend robustness, and (4) component architecture,
  maintainability, and refactoring opportunities.
- Give every reviewer the same relevant files or diff plus its assigned focus.
  Ask for concrete, evidence-backed findings and a ranked refactoring proposal;
  avoid implementation changes in the review call.
- After all reviews return, synthesize the findings and propose a refactoring
  plan. Critically assess each recommendation against the actual code, product
  intent, regression risk, project conventions, and the user's scope. Accept
  only supported recommendations; explain rejected material suggestions rather
  than applying them automatically.
- Verify and address accepted findings within the user's requested scope. If a
  reviewer cannot run, retry that review once; if fewer than four reviews
  complete, disclose the incomplete review rather than presenting it as a
  four-way review.

## Commands

```powershell
# Interactive
rtk agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --model gemini-3.8-flash-high --effort high

# Delegated one-shot
rtk agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --model gemini-3.8-flash-high --effort high --print "<task>"
```

Return the worker's result to the caller and verify any claimed file changes or
test results before treating the delegation as complete.

# "지금 TETH가 하는 일" 판단 카드 시안 경쟁 브리프

위치: AI 트레이딩 랜딩(index.html `tfIntroView`, 히어로 바로 아래 섹션 `#txh-now`). 현재 카드: ux-audit/card/current.png. 섹션 제목 "지금 TETH가 하는 일"과 리드 문장은 유지, 카드만 새로 설계한다. 카드 최대 폭 680px, 배경 다크(#0f1012 계열), 카드 면 var(--g1) 톤(#15171a 근처), 라임 사용 금지(이 섹션에는 1차 행동이 없다).

## 카드에 들어갈 것 (이것만)
1. 이미지: 워렌 버핏 얼굴 사진 `assets/buffett.jpg` (480x480, 정사각). 원형 또는 둥근 사각 아바타로.
2. 전략명: `워렌 버핏 AI_버전13` (그대로, 띄어쓰기·언더바 유지)
3. 거래소: 바이낸스 작은 원형 로고 `assets/logos/app-binance.png` (지름 18~22px, 전략명 옆 또는 아바타 모서리)
4. 본문(그대로, 한 글자도 바꾸지 말 것):
   "제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다. NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다."

## 넣지 말 것
"시뮬레이션 예시" 배지, "지금은 기다려요" 칩, 종목명 칩(비트코인), "주문 없음", "다음 확인 15분 뒤", 번호 목록. 그 밖의 메타 요소(시각, 상태 점 등)는 1개까지만 허용하되 이유를 노트에 적는다.

// Minimal CDP driver over Node's built-in WebSocket (no npm deps).
// Drives headless Chrome on 127.0.0.1:9333 for the reference audit.
import fs from 'node:fs';

export const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

export class CDP {
  constructor(ws) {
    this.ws = ws; this.id = 0; this.pend = new Map(); this.listeners = new Map();
    ws.addEventListener('message', ev => {
      const m = JSON.parse(ev.data);
      if (m.id && this.pend.has(m.id)) {
        const { res, rej } = this.pend.get(m.id); this.pend.delete(m.id);
        m.error ? rej(new Error(m.error.message)) : res(m.result);
      } else if (m.method) {
        const l = this.listeners.get(m.method); if (l) l.forEach(f => f(m.params));
      }
    });
  }
  static async connect(wsUrl) {
    const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
    await new Promise((res, rej) => { ws.addEventListener('open', res); ws.addEventListener('error', e => rej(new Error('ws error'))); });
    return new CDP(ws);
  }
  send(method, params = {}, timeoutMs = 25000) {
    const id = ++this.id;
    this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => { if (this.pend.has(id)) { this.pend.delete(id); rej(new Error('CDP timeout: ' + method)); } }, timeoutMs);
      this.pend.set(id, { res: v => { clearTimeout(t); res(v); }, rej: e => { clearTimeout(t); rej(e); } });
    });
  }
  on(method, fn) {
    if (!this.listeners.has(method)) this.listeners.set(method, []);
    this.listeners.get(method).push(fn);
  }
  off(method) { this.listeners.delete(method); }
}

export async function newPage(port = 9333) {
  const t = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/new?about:blank`, { method: 'PUT' }).then(r => r.json());
  const c = await CDP.connect(t.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  c.targetId = t.id;
  await c.send('Page.enable');
  await c.send('Runtime.enable');
  await c.send('Network.enable');
  // Plain (non-headless) UA so the reference serves its normal experience
  const ver = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/version`).then(r => r.json());
  const ua = ver['User-Agent'].replace('HeadlessChrome', 'Chrome');
  await c.send('Network.setUserAgentOverride', { userAgent: ua, acceptLanguage: 'en-US,en' });
  return c;
}

export async function closePage(c, port = 9333) {
  try { await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/close/${c.targetId}`); } catch {}
}

export async function evala(c, expr) {
  const r = await c.send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: expr, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
  if (r.exceptionDetails) throw new Error('evala: ' + JSON.stringify(r.exceptionDetails).slice(0, 600));
  return r.result.value;
}

export async function goto(c, url, settleMs = 1500, timeoutMs = 30000) {
  await c.send('Page.navigate', { url });
  const t0 = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - t0 < timeoutMs) {
    try { if (await evala(c, 'document.readyState') === 'complete') break; } catch {}
    await sleep(300);
  }
  await sleep(settleMs);
}

export async function viewport(c, w, h, { dsf = 1, mobile = false, dark = true } = {}) {
  await c.send('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: w, height: h, deviceScaleFactor: dsf, mobile, screenWidth: w, screenHeight: h });
  await c.send('Emulation.setEmulatedMedia', { features: [{ name: 'prefers-color-scheme', value: dark ? 'dark' : 'light' }] });
  if (mobile) await c.send('Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled', { enabled: true, maxTouchPoints: 5 });
  else await c.send('Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled', { enabled: false });
}

export async function shot(c, path, { full = true, clip = null } = {}) {
  const params = { format: 'png' };
  if (clip) params.clip = { x: Math.max(0, clip.x), y: Math.max(0, clip.y), width: Math.max(1, clip.width), height: Math.max(1, clip.height), scale: 1 };
  else if (full) params.captureBeyondViewport = true;
  const { data } = await c.send('Page.captureScreenshot', params, 90000);
  fs.writeFileSync(path, Buffer.from(data, 'base64'));
  return path;
}

// Element screenshot by selector (first visible match)
export async function shotEl(c, path, selector, pad = 0) {
  const box = await evala(c, `(()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)})];for(const e of els){const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(b.width>2&&b.height>2)return {x:b.x+scrollX,y:b.y+scrollY,width:b.width,height:b.height};}return null;})()`);
  if (!box) return null;
  return shot(c, path, { clip: { x: box.x - pad, y: box.y - pad, width: box.width + pad * 2, height: box.height + pad * 2 } });
}

export async function move(c, x, y) { await c.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseMoved', x, y }); }
export async function click(c, x, y) {
  await move(c, x, y);
  await c.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mousePressed', x, y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 });
  await c.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseReleased', x, y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 });
}
export async function clickSel(c, selector) {
  const box = await evala(c, `(()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)})];for(const e of els){const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(b.width>2&&b.height>2)return {x:b.x+b.width/2,y:b.y+b.height/2};}return null;})()`);
  if (!box) throw new Error('clickSel: not found ' + selector);
  await click(c, box.x, box.y);
  return box;
}

const VK = { Escape: 27, Enter: 13, Tab: 9, Space: 32, ArrowDown: 40, ArrowUp: 38, ArrowLeft: 37, ArrowRight: 39 };
export async function key(c, name, modifiers = 0) {
  const code = VK[name]; const text = name === 'Enter' ? '\r' : name === 'Space' ? ' ' : '';
  await c.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'rawKeyDown', windowsVirtualKeyCode: code, key: name, modifiers });
  if (text) await c.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'char', text });
  await c.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyUp', windowsVirtualKeyCode: code, key: name, modifiers });
}

// Motion recording: screencast frames with timestamps while fn() runs.
export async function record(c, dir, name, fn, extraMs = 900) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const frames = [];
  c.on('Page.screencastFrame', async p => {
    frames.push({ ts: p.metadata.timestamp, data: p.data });
    try { await c.send('Page.screencastFrameAck', { sessionId: p.sessionId }); } catch {}
  });
  await c.send('Page.startScreencast', { format: 'png', everyNthFrame: 1 });
  await fn();
  await sleep(extraMs);
  await c.send('Page.stopScreencast');
  c.off('Page.screencastFrame');
  const meta = [];
  frames.forEach((f, i) => {
    const fp = `${dir}/${name}-f${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.png`;
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, Buffer.from(f.data, 'base64'));
    meta.push({ frame: i, ts: f.ts, file: fp.split('/').pop() });
  });
  fs.writeFileSync(`${dir}/${name}-timeline.json`, JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2));
  return meta.length;
}

// Measurement helper injected into pages: styleOf(selector) -> full computed+rect record
export const MEASURE_LIB = `
window.__m = {
  rect(el){ const b=el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:+b.x.toFixed(1),y:+b.y.toFixed(1),w:+b.width.toFixed(1),h:+b.height.toFixed(1)}; },
  style(el){
    const s=getComputedStyle(el);
    const pick=['display','position','flexDirection','justifyContent','alignItems','gridTemplateColumns','gap','rowGap','columnGap',
      'padding','paddingTop','paddingRight','paddingBottom','paddingLeft','margin','marginTop','marginBottom','marginLeft','marginRight',
      'maxWidth','minWidth','minHeight','width','height',
      'fontFamily','fontSize','fontWeight','lineHeight','letterSpacing','textTransform','whiteSpace',
      'color','backgroundColor','backgroundImage','border','borderWidth','borderColor','borderStyle','borderRadius','boxShadow','opacity',
      'transitionProperty','transitionDuration','transitionDelay','transitionTimingFunction','transform','transformOrigin','overflow','overflowX','cursor','zIndex'];
    const o={}; for(const k of pick) o[k]=s[k]; return o;
  },
  el(sel,i){ const els=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].filter(e=>{const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();return b.width>1&&b.height>1;}); return els[i||0]||null; },
  cap(sel,i){ const e=this.el(sel,i); if(!e) return null; return {sel:sel, rect:this.rect(e), style:this.style(e), text:(e.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,120), tag:e.tagName, cls:(e.className&&e.className.baseVal!==undefined?e.className.baseVal:e.className||'').toString().slice(0,160)}; },
  capAll(sel,limit){ const els=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].filter(e=>{const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();return b.width>1&&b.height>1;}).slice(0,limit||10); return els.map(e=>({rect:this.rect(e), style:this.style(e), text:(e.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,80)})); }
};
'lib-ready'`;

import http from 'node:http'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path';
const root=process.argv[2]; const port=+process.argv[3]||8765;
const mime={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript','.mjs':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json','.mp4':'video/mp4','.woff2':'font/woff2','.webp':'image/webp'};
http.createServer((req,res)=>{
  let p=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]); if(p.endsWith('/')) p+='index.html';
  let f=path.join(root,p); if(fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()) f=path.join(f,'index.html');
  if(!fs.existsSync(f)){ res.writeHead(404); res.end('404'); return; }
  res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':mime[path.extname(f).toLowerCase()]||'application/octet-stream','cache-control':'no-store'});
  fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);
}).listen(port,()=>console.log('serving',root,'on',port));

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="ko">

+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@500&display=swap">
+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

+<!doctype html>

+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">

+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+콘셉트: 트레이더 프로필 아래에 판단 전문이 이어지는 담백한 프로필 카드다. 추가 메타 요소는 없다.

+타이포: 본문은 system-ui/Pretendard 계열 16px·행간 1.7, 원문 두 문장 사이에만 문단 여백 16px을 뒀다.
+390 대응: 페이지 좌우 20px, 카드 안쪽 좌우 20px, 본문 15px로 조정하고 아바타·로고 크기를 유지한다.
+위험: 독립 시안의 Noto Serif KR은 Google Fonts 로드 실패 시 기기별 명조 대체 글꼴로 표시된다.
+확인 주소: http://localhost:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html — 1440×900·390×844 렌더, 원문·이미지·가로 넘침 확인.
diff --git a/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html b/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="ko">
+<head>
+  <meta charset="utf-8">
+  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
+  <title>지금 TETH가 하는 일 — Codex 판단 카드</title>
+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@500&display=swap">
+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..87d44a6eb0ce26399ce8092e73c877f8a0b09fa9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }
diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aa9ab8aaeac15947339d175b917e4616fa4e19c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="ko">
+<head>
+  <meta charset="utf-8">
+  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
+  <title>지금 TETH가 하는 일 — Codex 판단 카드</title>
+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;700&family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@500&display=swap">
+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", "Noto Sans KR", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    await c.send('DOM.enable'); await c.send('CSS.enable');
+    const doc = await c.send('DOM.getDocument');
+    const node = await c.send('DOM.querySelector',{nodeId:doc.root.nodeId,selector:'.analysis p'});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result,fonts:await c.send('CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode',{nodeId:node.nodeId})}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. +    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }

+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+try {

+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});

+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

 | `about/index.html` | 제품 소개, 기능 설명, 요금제, 신뢰·위험 안내, FAQ, 최종 CTA를 제공한다. 요금제는 `site-config.js`에서 렌더링한다. |

+import fs from 'node:fs';

+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }

+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="ko">
+<head>
+  <meta charset="utf-8">
+  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
+  <title>지금 TETH가 하는 일 — Codex 판단 카드</title>
+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;700&family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@500&display=swap">
+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", "Noto Sans KR", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }
diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aa9ab8aaeac15947339d175b917e4616fa4e19c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..87d44a6eb0ce26399ce8092e73c877f8a0b09fa9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }
diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aa9ab8aaeac15947339d175b917e4616fa4e19c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

 | `theme.js` | 다크 테마만 강제하고 `tethTheme` 값을 저장한다. 현재 테마 선택 기능은 없다. |
 | `about/index.html` | 제품 소개, 기능 설명, 요금제, 신뢰·위험 안내, FAQ, 최종 CTA를 제공한다. 요금제는 `site-config.js`에서 렌더링한다. |

@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+콘셉트: 트레이더 프로필 아래에 판단 전문이 이어지는 담백한 프로필 카드다. 추가 메타 요소는 없다.
+배치: 44px 원형 아바타 → 굵은 전략명 → 이름 옆 20px 원형 바이낸스 로고를 한 행에 묶었다.
+타이포: 본문은 system-ui/Pretendard 계열(한글 대체 Noto Sans KR) 16px·행간 1.7, 원문 두 문장 사이에만 문단 여백 16px을 뒀다.
+390 대응: 페이지 좌우 20px, 카드 안쪽 좌우 20px, 본문 15px로 조정하고 아바타·로고 크기를 유지한다.
+위험: Google Fonts 로드 실패 시 기기별 대체 글꼴로 표시되어 제목 모양과 본문 줄바꿈이 달라질 수 있다.
+확인 주소: http://localhost:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html — 1440×900·390×844 렌더, 원문·이미지·가로 넘침 확인.

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="ko">
+<head>
+  <meta charset="utf-8">
+  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
+  <title>지금 TETH가 하는 일 — Codex 판단 카드</title>
+  <link rel="icon" href="../../assets/favicon.png">
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;700&family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@500&display=swap">
+  <style>
+    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
+    :root { color-scheme: dark; background: #0f1012; color: #f0f1f2; }
+    body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, "Pretendard", "Noto Sans KR", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
+    main { width: min(100% - 48px, 680px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 176px 0 96px; }
+    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: "Noto Serif KR", "Nanum Myeongjo", Batang, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.025em; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .lead { margin: 14px 0 32px; color: #a1a6ae; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; word-break: keep-all; }
+    .trader-card { padding: 28px; background: #15171a; border: 1px solid #2b2e33; border-radius: 18px; }
+    .profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
+    .avatar { display: block; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+    h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.02em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .exchange { display: block; flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }
+    .analysis { margin-top: 22px; color: #c9cdd3; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -.012em; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
+    .analysis p { margin: 0; }
+    .analysis p + p { margin-top: 16px; }
+    @media (max-width: 600px) {
+      main { width: calc(100% - 40px); padding: 72px 0 56px; }
+      h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
+      .lead { margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 15px; }
+      .trader-card { padding: 22px 20px; }
+      .profile { gap: 12px; }
+      h2 { font-size: 15px; }
+      .identity { gap: 7px; }
+      .analysis { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 15px; }
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+  <main>
+    <section aria-labelledby="section-title">
+      <h1 id="section-title">지금 TETH가 하는 일</h1>
+      <p class="lead">사고팔 때만이 아니라 기다릴 때도, 왜 그렇게 했는지 직접 적어둬요.</p>
+      <article class="trader-card" aria-labelledby="strategy-name">
+        <header class="profile">
+          <img class="avatar" src="../../assets/buffett.jpg" alt="워렌 버핏" width="44" height="44">
+          <div class="identity">
+            <h2 id="strategy-name">워렌 버핏 AI_버전13</h2>
+            <img class="exchange" src="../../assets/logos/app-binance.png" alt="바이낸스" width="20" height="20">
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <div class="analysis">
+          <p>제 분석에 따르면 NVDA와 MSFT 같은 AI 관련 기업들의 강세가 지속될 것으로 예상되어, 주말 유동성 감소와 거시 경제 이벤트 위험에도 불구하고 기존 롱 포지션을 유지하고 있으며, 당분간 신규 거래나 헤지 포지션은 추가하지 않을 예정입니다.</p>
+          <p>NVDA의 지지선과 MSFT의 상승 추세를 면밀히 모니터링하며, 추세가 무너질 경우 조정할 준비를 하고 있습니다.</p>
+        </div>
+      </article>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+</body>
+</html>

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..87d44a6eb0ce26399ce8092e73c877f8a0b09fa9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-check.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {newPage, closePage, viewport, goto, evala, shot} from 'file:///C:/Users/hyun1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-hyun1-OneDrive------/3eeecebb-9375-4ed0-850b-52929f00da99/scratchpad/pw/cdp.mjs';
+const c = await newPage();
+const errors = [];
+c.on('Runtime.exceptionThrown', p => errors.push(p));
+c.on('Network.loadingFailed', p => errors.push(p.errorText));
+c.on('Network.responseReceived', p => {if(p.response.status >= 400) errors.push(p.response.url + ' ' + p.response.status);});
+try {
+  for(const [width,height,mobile,suffix] of [[1440,900,false,'d1440'],[390,844,true,'m390']]) {
+    await viewport(c,width,height,{mobile});
+    await goto(c,'http://127.0.0.1:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html');
+    await evala(c,'document.fonts.ready.then(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(i => i.decode())))');
+    const result=await evala(c,`(() => {
+      const rect = s => { const r=document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height,bottom:r.bottom}; };
+      return {body:[...document.querySelectorAll('.analysis p')].map(p=>p.textContent).join(' '),title:document.querySelector('h2').textContent,card:rect('.trader-card'),avatar:rect('.avatar'),logo:rect('.exchange'),identity:rect('.identity'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,images:[...document.images].map(i=>({src:i.getAttribute('src'),loaded:i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0})),fontLoaded:document.fonts.check('500 36px "Noto Serif KR"'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).fontSize,lineHeight:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.analysis')).lineHeight};
+    })()`);
+    const brief=fs.readFileSync('ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md','utf8');
+    assert(brief.includes('"'+result.body+'"'),'body matches brief');
+    assert.equal(result.title,'워렌 버핏 AI_버전13');
+    assert.equal(result.avatar.w,44); assert.equal(result.avatar.h,44);
+    assert.equal(result.logo.w,20); assert.equal(result.logo.h,20);
+    assert(result.card.w<=680); assert(result.card.bottom<=height);
+    assert(!result.overflow); assert(result.images.every(i=>i.loaded));
+    await shot(c,`ux-audit/card/mock-codex-${suffix}.png`,{full:false});
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({width,height,...result}));
+  }
+  assert.equal(errors.length,0,JSON.stringify(errors));
+  console.log('PASS: exact copy, asset loading, layout dimensions, no overflow or browser errors.');
+} finally { await closePage(c); c.ws.close(); }
diff --git a/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aa9ab8aaeac15947339d175b917e4616fa4e19c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.mailbox/card-codex-review.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));

 | `ux-audit/research/AI_MODELS_TRADING.md`, `ux-audit/research/CODEX_VERIFY_MODELS.md` | 거래 판단과 Pine Script 작성 모델의 Claude 조사 초안 및 Codex 항목별 검증. 공식 출처 대조, 미확정 수치, 호출 비용과 조합 수정안을 기록한다. 실제 모델 성능 실험이나 제품 구현 완료 명세가 아니다. |
 | `site-config.js` | 자주 바뀌는 공용 설정의 단일 진실 공급원. 앱 진입 경로, iOS·Android 스토어 URL, Zendesk 키, 요금제 데이터를 관리한다. |
+| `ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html`, `ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md`, `ux-audit/card/mock-codex-d1440.png`, `ux-audit/card/mock-codex-m390.png` | 판단 카드 경쟁의 Codex 트레이더 프로필 시안, 6줄 구현 노트와 1440×900·390×844 렌더. 포트 8803의 한국어 전용 독립 HTML이며 본문 앱에는 적용하지 않았다. |
 | `help-widget.js` | 모든 페이지에서 재사용하는 다국어 고객지원 플로팅 버튼. Zendesk 키가 없으면 준비 안내를 표시한다. |
 | `theme.js` | 다크 테마만 강제하고 `tethTheme` 값을 저장한다. 현재 테마 선택 기능은 없다. |
 | `about/index.html` | 제품 소개, 기능 설명, 요금제, 신뢰·위험 안내, FAQ, 최종 CTA를 제공한다. 요금제는 `site-config.js`에서 렌더링한다. |

+콘셉트: 트레이더 프로필 아래에 판단 전문이 이어지는 담백한 프로필 카드다. 추가 메타 요소는 없다.
+배치: 44px 원형 아바타 → 굵은 전략명 → 이름 옆 20px 원형 바이낸스 로고를 한 행에 묶었다.
+타이포: 본문은 system-ui/Pretendard 계열(한글 대체 Noto Sans KR) 16px·행간 1.7, 원문 두 문장 사이에만 문단 여백 16px을 뒀다.
+390 대응: 페이지 좌우 20px, 카드 안쪽 좌우 20px, 본문 15px로 조정하고 아바타·로고 크기를 유지한다.
+위험: Google Fonts 로드 실패 시 기기별 대체 글꼴로 표시되어 제목 모양과 본문 줄바꿈이 달라질 수 있다.
+검증: http://localhost:8803/ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html — 1440×900·390×844 렌더, 원문·이미지·가로 넘침 통과; AGY 4관점 검토는 인증·접근 권한 오류로 미완료.

+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+const focuses=['visual hierarchy and design consistency','responsive behavior and accessibility','interaction states, data handling, and frontend robustness','component architecture, maintainability, and refactoring opportunities'];
+await Promise.all(focuses.map(async (focus) => {
+  for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
+    const prompt=`Review only; do not modify files or delegate. Focus: ${focus}. Read ux-audit/card/BRIEF.md and ux-audit/card/mock-codex.html, ux-audit/card/NOTE-codex.md and inspect mock-codex-d1440.png and mock-codex-m390.png in that folder. User explicitly requests a standalone profile card, only prescribed content, no index.html changes. Report concrete evidence-backed findings and ranked refactoring proposal. Keep recommendations within scope; no refactor is valid if no issue exists. Maximum 250 words.`;
+    const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
+      let output='';
+      const proc=spawn('rtk',['agy','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--model','gemini-3.8-flash-high','--effort','high','--print',prompt],{env:{...process.env,CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:'C:/Users/hyun1/.claude'},windowsHide:true});
+      proc.stdout.on('data',d=>output+=d);proc.stderr.on('data',d=>output+=d);
+      proc.on('error',e=>resolve({code:-1,output:e.message}));
+      proc.on('close',code=>resolve({code,output}));
+    });
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({focus,attempt,...result}));
+    if(result.code===0)break;
+  }
+}));
